theme: Light mode primary (Soft Pastel Pink, Whimsical & Elegant).

palette.text_primary: Deep Charcoal/Plum (#2A1A1E) for high contrast and readability

colors.contrast_rules: Text on pink or white backgrounds MUST be Deep Charcoal (#2A1A1E). Never use light gray on pink. Interactive elements must darken on hover.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' variant with a feminine editorial twist.

headings.style: Elegant, serif, refined, tight tracking for large sizes.

body.style: Clean geometric sans, highly readable for tech context.

labels.style: Uppercase, wide tracking, text-xs to text-sm.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-12, p-16, p-24 for section padding.
layouts.hero: Kinetic Hero. Full height. Masked line-by-line reveal of 'Anshita Verma'. Subtle parallax abstract pink fluid background.
layouts.bento_grid: MODE A: THE 'TETRIS' GRID for Skills section. Asymmetrical grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with gap-8.
layouts.projects: Showcase with clipped frames (rounded-[2rem]). Product-photography-style image treatment.
layouts.experience: Vertical timeline. Deep charcoal tracking line, glowing soft pink nodes.
layouts.manifesto: Numbered manifesto chapters (01, 02, 03) for the About section.
layouts.marquee: Slow editorial marquee using react-fast-marquee. Very slow, smooth drift. Pale pink background, dark plum text. Serif font. gap-32.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for sticky headers and overlapping cards: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/40 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(42,26,30,0.05)].
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay globally to give a magazine/editorial feel.

motion.scroll: Use lenis for smooth, premium momentum scrolling.
motion.page_load: Staggered Framer Motion reveals. Name text uses clip-path or overflow-hidden for line-by-line slide up.
motion.scroll_reveals: Framer motion whileInView. Elements fade up and slightly scale in over 0.8s.
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons: scale down slightly on click. Links: Underline expand on hover.

component_instructions.nav_bar: Sticky header with Crystal Glassmorphism. NEVER use a fully transparent header.
component_instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary: bg-pink-200 text-charcoal hover:bg-pink-300 transition-colors.

image_urls.description: Abstract pastel pink fluid form for 3D/Parallax background effect.
Pink and white abstract painting for section transitions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required packages: framer-motion, react-fast-marquee, @studio-freight/react-lenis, lucide-react
Use .js or .jsx extensions for all files. DO NOT output .tsx files.

Apply fonts via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;1,400&family=Outfit:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap');
Update tailwind.config.js to include font families: `serif: ['Cormorant Garamond', 'serif'], sans: ['Outfit', 'sans-serif']`.

Update index.css variables for Light Theme: --background: 340 20% 98%; --foreground: 343 25% 14%; --primary: 346 100% 91%; --primary-foreground: 343 25% 14%; --border: 340 20% 90%; --card: 0 0% 100%; --card-foreground: 343 25% 14%;

For the Kinetic Hero: Create a Framer Motion component in .jsx that splits 'Anshita Verma' into words or lines, wrapping them in an overflow-hidden span, animating `y` from 100% to 0%. Implement Parallax/3D using useScroll and useTransform on the fluid background image.
For the slow editorial marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Content should be tech & ML keywords mixed with whimsical descriptors.
Ensure the header navigation is sticky (z-50) using Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70). NEVER use a fully transparent header.
Contact form must have a real setup. Use a simple mock submit or purely frontend validation for now, but design it beautifully with floating labels or editorial bottom-border-only inputs.
Every interactive element MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. e.g., transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
